complete_student_policy.composition: bounded nominal plus Transformer correction; actual issued/applied feedback

batch_execution.native_rng: Persistent batch event stream; native indexed reset without reseeding other lanes; no hidden-state parity claim

contact.scope: filtered normal forces; not native success

tanh_saturation.reason: Versioned proposal is linear or has a true linear tail; legacy amplitude ratio does not measure saturation

observed_contact_loss_regain.definition: Any finger observed normal resultant >0.1N, valid current observation; gaps require uninterrupted valid observations
observed_contact_loss_regain.interpretation: Recontact is a sensor event, not successful recovery; no recovery supervision or causal capability is established

legacy_normalized_amplitude.definition: abs(proposed_delta_normalized)/historical_scales; not a derivative or model bound

native_inference.timing_scope: Observed call wall times and asynchronous current-CUDA-stream elapsed intervals; no added synchronize/wait; stream intervals include CPU submission gaps, not pure kernel time
native_inference.wall_scope: Native planning includes observation, DINO/depth, history, DDIM and required CPU return; native history-only calls may return before queued CUDA work completes
native_inference.excludes: resource waits, environment stepping/rendering, result serialization

configuration.segment_rule: Increase at control-source or supervision-validity changes; never join across episode reset
configuration.supervision_rule: Student prefix and the complete expert-delay queue flush have mask0; clean executed expert suffix only
configuration.q_reached_rule: Actual same-transition post-integration joint state; never a counterfactual expert response
configuration.expert_delay_rule: Continuous shadow queue; same single draw retained by the position executor; native queue untouched

dagger.admission: Only verified successful real expert suffixes enter training

trigger_receipt.phase_alignment: next action after causal confirmation; original planner phase retained
trigger_receipt.limitation: A collection screen, not a proven harmful error or guaranteed expert recoverability

population.early_window_scope: First valid tick onward, stopping at the first invalid tick or control-segment change

recovery_coverage.tick_index: zero-based pre-action switch; supervision starts only after the real queue flush

profile.timing_scope: main submission and worker times overlap; do not sum into rollout wall time

wall_profile.scope: Overlapping lane lifetime, including final drain and validation; use wave wall for throughput

timing.interpretation: Lane lifetimes overlap; use batch wave total for throughput
